remarks: Welcome to this impressive 5-bedroom, 4-bathroom home tucked inside one of Rancho Santa Margarita’s coveted gated communities. Set on a quiet cul-de-sac with no rear neighbors, this property offers the kind of privacy, space, &  resort-style living that is hard to find in such a convenient location. From the moment you enter, the home makes a grand first impression with a soaring foyer, abundant natural light, and an elegant sense of arrival. The formal living room and spacious formal dining room create the perfect setting for holidays, gatherings, and special occasions, while the open-concept kitchen and family room are designed for everyday living and easy entertaining.
